worktrees.title: Git worktrees
worktrees.nativeContract: Switch moves this native session and its artifacts to the selected checkout, retaining its ID. Other sessions are not copied or moved. Branches and user changes are never force-deleted.
worktrees.workspaceContract: Choose the checkout for your next native session. Browsing and workspace selection do not start an Agent or save chat history.
worktrees.busy: Native session is busy. Browsing is read-only; switching waits for its work to settle.
worktrees.unavailable: This runtime does not advertise native session relocation.
worktrees.unavailableTarget: Selected worktree is no longer available
worktrees.identityMismatch: Native worktree switch did not return the same session identity
worktrees.removeHint: Only clean linked worktrees (no uncommitted changes) can be removed
worktrees.pathHint: Suggested from the branch name; absolute or relative to the current workspace.

gitStaging.wholeFile: Binary, truncated, new/deleted, renamed or mode-changing files must be selected as a whole file.
gitStaging.scope: Only these staged files will be committed. Unstaged changes remain untouched:
gitStaging.cancelled: Commit cancelled; index and HEAD unchanged.
gitStaging.safety: No automatic staging. Review every staged file before confirming. Repository hooks run normally.

htmlPreview.resourcesTruncated: Some local resources could not be loaded because the preview reached its resource budget.

fileExplorer.selectProject: Select a project to browse files
fileExplorer.deleteConfirmDir: Delete {{path}} and all of its contents?
fileExplorer.serverChanged: The server changed. Reopen the file before saving this draft.

extensionsPanel.empty: No extension output for this session
extensionsPanel.diagnosticsHint: The official runtime does not identify the originating session. These errors are recorded at the extension host level, without assigning them to the current session.
extensionsPanel.title: Title

sessionTree.runtimeControlsHint: Manage context compaction and automatic retries after failures
sessionTree.queueHint: Queued messages appear at the end of the conversation. One at a time: deliver one and wait for the reply; All: deliver everything at the delivery point
sessionTree.toolsHint: Choose which tools the Agent can use in this session
sessionTree.importHint: Restore a Pi session copy from a JSONL file
sessionTree.nativeEntry: Native entry (including tool results and metadata)
sessionTree.navigationCancelled: Native operation cancelled; the source session and draft were preserved.
sessionTree.navigationAborted: Branch summary aborted; the source session and draft were preserved.
sessionTree.navigateUserHint: Moves context before this user message and restores it to the editor. Sending it again creates a sibling branch.
sessionTree.navigateEntryHint: Makes this entry the current context. New messages continue from here as a new branch.
sessionTree.label: Edit label
sessionTree.importPath: Path to a Pi JSONL file
sessionTree.compactHint: Compact the session context now to reduce token usage; optionally note what to keep
sessionTree.autoCompactionHint: Automatically compact context when it grows too large
sessionTree.autoRetryHint: Automatically retry failed requests with exponential backoff
sessionTree.summarizeNavigation: Summarize the abandoned branch when navigating
sessionTree.steeringHint: Messages sent with Enter while the Agent is running, inserted at a safe point in the current turn
sessionTree.followUpHint: Messages queued while the Agent is running, sent as a new turn after it finishes
sessionTree.interruptModeHint: Current-session steering behavior; Stop and Interrupt & prompt explicitly abort in either mode
sessionTree.interruptModeDetail: Immediate signals running tools to yield; Wait lets non-interruptible work finish. Pure waits can be cut short in both modes

sessionChanges.noGitHint: Version control details are unavailable for this directory
sessionChanges.gitScopeHint: Uncommitted files in the working tree
sessionChanges.branchScopeHint: All changes on this branch since {{branch}}
sessionChanges.stagedScopeHint: Changes currently staged in the Git index
sessionChanges.unstagedScopeHint: Working tree changes not staged in the Git index

desktopService.title: Local backend
desktopService.outputHint: The latest 24 lines are shown locally and are not automatically included in shareable fault reports.
desktopService.noOutput: No backend output yet. Check the startup phase above if no process has been created.
desktopService.noEvents: No startup operation has been recorded in this window. The start time of an existing service may be unknown.
desktopService.runtimeHint: Once the engine is ready, it can handle tasks. Session runtimes start on demand when sending messages or making changes. Browsing history or opening this panel does not start a runtime.
desktopService.queryFailed: Desktop service status is temporarily unavailable. Retrying.
desktopService.healthRejected: The backend rejected its health check. Check the local service authentication settings.

dialog.questionnaireNotApproval: These answers are not approval for another operation.
dialog.timedOut: Automatically selected by native ask after timeout; not an explicit user approval.
dialog.askAvailable: Native ask is active; the questionnaire response bridge is ready.
dialog.askBasicAvailable: Native ask is active; only the official select/editor fallback is available.
dialog.askRuntimeUnavailable: The native runtime is unavailable; no ask answer can be submitted.
dialog.askInactive: Native ask is not active (disabled by native settings or excluded by the tool set).
